en.title: Reeeead — Open-source text to speech & reading ruler for Mac
en.description: Read selected text aloud and keep your place with a two-click reading band. A small, open-source macOS reading companion with system voices and your own speech API.
en.eyebrow: A LITTLE READING COMPANION FOR MAC
en.heading:
Read a little
easier.
en.intro:
For the sentence you've read three times.
Give your ears a turn. Give your eyes some room.
en.note:
Eyes: finished.
Brain: sorry, who are you?
en.artalt: A bewildered little pixel creature sits inside an open book.
en.demoDesc: Set the top. Set the bottom. The rest of the screen dims. Your reading band stays in place while you scroll and click as usual.
en.demoHint: Interactive illustration — move the band below.
en.sample: You don't have to wrestle every page into submission. Sometimes, a little less noise is enough. Leave some room for the line you're on. The next one will wait.
en.demoFoot: In the app: ⌃⌥L → click the top → click the bottom. Esc to close.
en.listenLabel: 02 / LET YOUR EARS TAKE A SHIFT
en.listenDesc: Select text in a supported Mac app and press your shortcut. Read with macOS voices, MiniMax, or a compatible speech API you configure yourself.
en.listenFoot: Keyboard or mouse side button. Your call.
en.smallDesc: A compact native window. Speech and a reading band up front; the knobs tucked away in settings. English or Chinese, following your system or your choice.
en.screenshotAlt: Real Reeeead app window in English with a text box, Read button and Ruler tab.
en.screenshotLabel: Actual app screenshot · English + Chinese interface
en.privacyDesc: No Reeeead account. No analytics. No reading history. System speech runs through macOS. If you choose a cloud voice, the text you ask to read goes to that provider. API keys stay in your Mac's Keychain.
en.filmDesc: 35 seconds. English narration and captions. One very confused little reader.
en.videoLabel: Illustrated demos + real app screenshot. AI-generated voice and illustration.
en.startTitle:
A little help.
Yours to make better.
en.startDesc: Free, MIT-licensed app code. Build it, use it, and help make reading feel a little lighter.
en.installNote: Source-first preview. No notarized one-click installer yet. Move the app to Applications before granting Accessibility permission.
faqs: Does the app support English?

Yes. The app follows your system language, with English and Simplified Chinese available. You can switch instantly in Settings → Shortcuts → App language. Your voice and shortcut settings stay the same.
Does it read every app or every PDF?
Selection support depends on the app. Reeeead tries macOS Accessibility, then an optional copy fallback. Image-only PDFs and screenshots need OCR, which isn't included.
Is this a treatment for dyslexia?
No. It is a reading aid, with selected-text speech and a screen reading band. No clinical benefit is claimed. Different readers prefer different tools.
Does it work on an external monitor?
The ruler targets the display your pointer is on when you start it. External-display and hardware compatibility testing is still ongoing; please report issues with your setup.
Is it free?
The app source is free under MIT. System speech needs no paid API key. External voice providers may charge for your usage.
Why does it need Accessibility permission?
To read selected text, handle shortcuts and mouse bindings, and exit the ruler with Esc. The ruler does not record your screen and needs no Screen Recording permission.

zh.title: Reeeead — 开源 Mac 选区朗读与屏幕阅读标尺
zh.description: 选中文字，一键朗读；点两下，固定屏幕阅读带。Reeeead 是轻量、原生、开源的 macOS 阅读辅助工具，支持系统语音、MiniMax 与兼容语音 API。
zh.eyebrow: 给 MAC 的一位小小阅读搭子
zh.heading:
读起来，
轻一点。
zh.intro:
献给已经读了三遍的那句话。
让耳朵接个班，给视线留点空间。
zh.meta: 开源 · macOS 14+ · 无需账号
zh.artalt: 一只发懵的像素小家伙坐在翻开的书里。
zh.demoLabel: 01 / 少一点干扰，多一点空间
zh.demoDesc: 定好上边界，再定下边界。阅读带之外变暗；固定后，区域留在屏幕原位，照常点击和滚动。
zh.demoHint: 交互示意：移动下方滑块，调整阅读带。
zh.sample: 不必把每一页都读成一场较量。有时候，只是需要少一点干扰。给眼前这一行留一点空间。下一行，可以等一下。你有自己的节奏，不必赶。
zh.demoFoot: 应用里：⌃⌥L → 点击上边界 → 点击下边界。Esc 退出。
zh.listenDesc: 在支持的 Mac 应用中选中文字，按下快捷键。可以使用 macOS 系统语音，也可以接入自己的 MiniMax 或兼容语音 API。
zh.audioLabel: MiniMax 示例 · 中文 · 合成语音
zh.listenFoot: 键盘组合键，或鼠标侧键。顺手就好。
zh.smallTitle:
两件实用的事，
一点点界面。
zh.smallDesc: 原生小窗口。朗读与标尺摆在前面，其余选项收进设置。中英双语，默认跟随系统，也可以手动切换。
zh.screenshotAlt: Reeeead 的真实应用窗口，包含试读文本框、朗读按钮与标尺标签。
zh.screenshotLabel: 真实应用截图 · 支持中英双语
zh.privacyDesc: 无需 Reeeead 账号，无遥测，不保存阅读历史。系统朗读使用 macOS 语音引擎；选择云端声音时，只有主动朗读的文字会发往你指定的服务。API Key 留在 Mac 钥匙串里。
zh.filmDesc: 34 秒认识 Reeeead。平静的旁白，中英字幕，还有一只读到发懵的小家伙。
zh.videoLabel: 功能动画示意 + 真实应用截图；合成旁白与生成插画。
zh.startTitle:
一点小帮助，
一起变得更好。
zh.startDesc: 应用代码免费、MIT 开源。自己构建，自己使用，也欢迎一起让阅读轻一点。
zh.installNote: 当前为源码预览版，尚无经过 Apple 公证的一键安装包。建议移到「应用程序」后，再授予辅助功能权限。
faqs: 可以切换英文界面吗？
可以。默认跟随系统语言；在设置 → 快捷键 → 界面语言中选择 English 或简体中文，立即生效，不改变已有语音与快捷键配置。
所有应用和 PDF 都能读吗？
取决于原应用的选区支持。Reeeead 先尝试 macOS 辅助功能接口，再使用可选的复制兼容模式。当前不含 OCR，不能直接朗读截图和纯图片 PDF。
它能治疗阅读障碍吗？
不能这样承诺。它是一款提供选区朗读和屏幕阅读带的辅助工具，不宣称临床效果。适合自己的阅读方式因人而异。
外接显示器能用吗？
标尺选择启动时鼠标所在的显示器。外接屏和不同硬件的兼容性仍在继续测试；遇到问题，欢迎附上设备情况反馈。
免费吗？
应用代码以 MIT 许可免费开源。系统语音不需要付费 API Key；外部声音服务可能根据使用量收费。
为什么需要辅助功能权限？
用于读取选中文字、处理快捷键和鼠标绑定，以及使用 Esc 退出标尺。标尺本身不录屏、不截图，不需要屏幕录制权限。
zh.footer: 少一点费劲，多一点阅读。
